system.description:
• Effect: You are Trained in Survival, Tracking, Set Snares and Climb (Book II) in the wilderness, on top of your starting skills, and Master in Tracking from 5th level. You read tracks (a trail's condition from 3rd level, the creature type from 5th), find food and shelter for yourself without a check and for 2d4 others on a Moderate check, and set and disarm wilderness traps (the Ranger Progression Table gives your trap search bonus and trap damage).
  • Conceal and Move Silently (Dexterity): in the wilderness, no penalty at half speed or slower, Disadvantage above it, impossible while running.
  • While Concealed you count as Hidden.
  • From 5th level you may attempt both together, at quarter speed, with Disadvantage on both.
  • Delay/Neutralise Poison (Wisdom): For natural poisons familiar to the ranger (those of their home region and their favoured enemy). On a successful check: delay the poison's effects for 1 hour per level (no action, 1 attempt only).
    • If the roll exceeds the needed total by 6 or more: neutralise the poison entirely (effects already suffered are not reversed)

activities.name: Conceal
activities.text: Camouflage yourself in the wilderness so passers-by cannot notice you.

activities.name: Delay/Neutralise Poison
activities.text: Delay a familiar natural poison for 1 hour per level, or neutralise it if you beat the total by 6 or more.

activities.name: Move Silently
activities.text: Move without sound in the wilderness; Disadvantage above half speed.

activities.name: Scale
activities.text: Climb a dangerous natural incline; failure makes no progress and failing by 5 or more means a fall.

activities.name: Traps
activities.text: Detect, set or disable simple wilderness traps. Your traps deal {1:1d4, 13:2d4, 18:3d4, 24:4d4}.

activities.name: Survival
activities.text: Forage to feed additional people beyond yourself.

activities.name: Track
activities.text: Track a creature in the wilderness, with Advantage, or hide your own tracks.
